senses.gloss: जट् €1 P. (जटति) To clot, become twisted or matted together (as hair).
जट a. [जट्-अच्; जन् उणा˚ टन् अन्त्यलोपश्च] Wearing twisted locks of hair.

जटा [Uṇ. 5. 30]
—1 The hair matted and twisted together, matted or clotted hair; जटाधरणसंस्कारं
 द्विजातित्वमवाप्य च Mb. 12. 61. 3. अंसव्यापि शकुन्तनीडनिचितं बिभ्रज्जटामण्डलम्
 Ś. 7. 11; जटाश्च बिभृयान्नित्यम् Ms. 6. 6; Māl. 1. 2.
—2 A fibrous root; यत्र मुञ्जावटे रामो जटाहरणमादिशत् Mb. 12. 122. 3.
—3 A particular manuer of reciting Vedic texts; thus the words नभः
 रुद्रेभ्यः repeated in this manner would stand thus:− नमो रुद्रेभ्यो
 रुद्रेभ्यो नमो नमो रुद्रेभ्यः
—4 A root in general; ज्ञानविज्ञानयोगेन कर्मणामुद्धरन् जटाः Bhāg. 3. 24. 17.
—5 A branch.
—6 The शतावरी plant.

जटा + -चीरः, -टङ्कः, -टीरः, -धरः, epithets of Śiva.

जटा + -धर + ({@-रः@})
—1 a mendicant or ascetic
—2 N. of a lexicographer.
—3 N. of a people in the south of India, Bṛ. S. 14. 13.

जटा + -जटः
—1 a mass of twisted hair (in general).
—2 the twisted hair of Śiva; जटाजूटग्रन्थौ यदसि विनिबद्धा पुरभिदा
 G. L. 14; पिङ्गोत्तुङ्गजटाजूटगतो यस्याश्नुते नवः Ks. 1. 18.
जटा + -ज्वालः a lamp.
जटा + -धर a. wearing matted hair.
जटा + -पाठः the Jaṭā arrangement of a Vedic text.
जटा + -भारः mass of braided hair.
जटा + -मण्डलम् braided hair forming a coil on the top of the head.
जटा + -मौलिः crest of (formed by) clotted hair; Ku. 2. 26.

जटायुः, जटायुस् m. A son of Śyeni and Aruṇa, a semi
 divine bird [He was a great friend of Daśaratha. He once saved his life
 while he was thrown down along with his car by Saturn against whom he
 had proceeded when a drought, said to be caused by the planet, well-nigh
 devastated the earth. While Rāvaṇa was carrying away Sītā, Jaṭāyu
 heard her cries in the chariot and fought most desperately with the formidable
 giant to rescue her from his grasp. But he was mortally wounded, and remained
 in that state till Rāma passed by that place in the course of his search
 after Sītā. The kind-hearted bird told Rāma that his wife had been
 carried away by Rāvaṇa and then breathed his last. His funeral rites
 were duly performed by Rāma and Lakṣmaṇa.]

जटाल a. [जटा अस्यर्थे सिध्मा˚ लच्]
—1 Wearing a coil of twisted hair; चर्मखण्डैकवसनो जटालः कृशधूसरः Ks. 53. 2.
—2 Collected together (like matted hair); दवदहनजटालज्वालजालाहतानाम् Bv. 1. 36.

जटाल + .{@-लः@} —1 The (Indian) fig-tree.
—2 Bdellium.
जटालक, जटिक a. Wearing twisted or braided hair.
जटालक, जटिक a. Wearing twisted or braided hair.

जटिः (-टी) f.
 [जट्-इन्]
—1 The (Indian) fig-tree.
—2 Clotted hair.
—3 An assemblage, multitude.

जटिः (-टी) f.
 [जट्-इन्]
—1 The (Indian) fig-tree.
—2 Clotted hair.
—3 An assemblage, multitude.

जटिन् (-नी f.) a.
 [जटा अस्त्यस्य इनि] Having twisted hair. ━m.
—1 An epithet of Śiva.
—2 The waved-leaf fig-tree (प्लक्ष)
—3 An elephant sixty years old.

जटिल a. [जटा अस्त्यर्थे इलच्]
—1 Wearing matted or twisted hair (as an ascetic); विवेश कश्चिज्जटिलस्तपोवनम्
 Ku. 5. 30; (जटिल may be here a noun meaning ‘an ascetic’); ज्येष्ठानुवृत्तिजटिलं
 च शिरोऽस्य साधोः R. 13. 78.
—2 Complicated, confused, intermixed, intermingled; विजानन्तो ऽप्येते
 वयमिह विपज्जालजटिलान् । न मुञ्चामः कामानहह गहनो मोहमहिमा
 Bh. 3. 21; शिखाकलाप˚ Pt. 2. 81; Ve. 2. 18.
—3 Dense, impervious; Bv. 1. 52.
जटिल + .{@-ला@} Long pepper.

जटिल + .{@-लः@}
—1 A lion.
—2 A goat.
—3 An ascetic.
—4 A Brāhmaṇa in the first period of his life.
जटिलय (Denom.) To crest or fill with; जगज्जालं ज्योस्त्नामयनवसुधाभिर्जटिलयन् Bv. 4. 1.

जटिलीकृ €8 U.
—1 To twist together, form into a braid
—2 To complicate, interweave.
जटिलीभावः Complication, confusion.
जटु(डु)लः [जट्-उलच् पृषो˚ टस्य डो वा] A freckle, mark.

जाटासुरिः N. of the demon Alaṃbuṣa; जाटासुरिर्भैमसेनिं नानाशस्त्रैरवाकिरत्
 Mb. 7. 174. 12.
